description: MainActivity.java for Jumping Jack Android app; handles sensor input, UI updates, and activity lifecycle for counting jumps based on gravity sensor data.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Main activity for Jumping Jack app; manages sensor events, UI, and jump counting logic.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes activity, views, sensor, and timer.

methods.name: setupViews
methods.description: Sets up ViewPager, indicators, and page change listener.

methods.name: onSensorChanged
methods.description: Handles gravity sensor updates to detect jumps.

methods.name: detectJump
methods.description: Detects up-down hand movements based on gravity sensor data.

methods.name: onJumpDetected
methods.description: Increments counter on successful jump detection.

methods.name: setCounter
methods.description: Updates UI, saves counter, and vibrates on multiples of 10.

methods.name: renewTimer
methods.description: Starts or resets timer to keep screen on.
